svg.title: Which notes each finding cites
svg.desc: Rows are the 15 findings, columns the 38 notes grouped by heading; a dot marks a note the finding cites. Finding 1 (answered): N24, N31, N38. Finding 2 (open): N13, N24, N32, N33. Finding 3 (open): N05, N15, N23. Finding 4 (open): N10, N18, N22. Finding 5 (open): N11, N12, N20, N21. Finding 6 (open): N14, N26, N37. Finding 7 (open): N23, N25, N29, N34. Finding 8 (open): N30. Finding 9 (open): N33, N35. Finding 10 (open): N28. Finding 11 (open): N19. Finding 12 (open): N27. Finding 13 (open): N01, N03, N04, N16, N17. Finding 14 (open): N09. Finding 15 (open): N07. Notes no finding cites: N02, N06, N08, N36. Notes with a ruling: N24, N31, N32, N38.
svg.text: grey id: no finding cites it
answered; the other findings are open
Is the inspection shape part of the contract?
Should a surface name what each trigger answers?
Should a lease have an identity?
Should the specification name its refusals and their order?
Is a requires that restates an invariant a guard?
Should one lease end’s or one tick’s entries be ordered?
Should readers be told shed_at does not order versions?
How are the temporal triggers processed?
Does a rejected action have a now?
Is a claim that hands nothing intended?
Does an idle pocket's position mean anything?
Should the specification fix its numeric domains?
Is “refused at configuration” the intended reading?
ArrivalPositionUnoccupied over a record and itself?
Finding 1 is answered (2026-11-20); the other fourteen are open. N02, N06, N08 and N15 record a reading; N36 is question 7, closed.
